scope: Reviewed prescription set for four actionable wheat pest and disease categories

final_online_library.use_in_online_agent: The online Prescription agent reads this reviewed set after diagnosis and outputs one preferred plan.

direct_base_reference.retrieval_setting: direct/base retrieval without DeepResearch evidence completion

candidate_records.reason: Intermediate construction logs are withheld from the lean review package. Count summaries and representative examples are provided.

representative_examples.dosage_and_method: 40-60 mL/mu, diluted with 40-50 kg water per mu, stem-and-leaf spray before disease occurrence or at the early disease stage
representative_examples.source_title: 2019 Integrated Control Technical Plan for Major Wheat Pests and Diseases

representative_examples.dosage_and_method: 32-64 g/mu, spray before disease occurrence or at the early disease stage
representative_examples.source_title: 2025 Technical Plan for Control of Major Grain Crop Pests and Diseases

representative_examples.dosage_and_method: 6-10 g/mu, spray at the early peak stage of wheat aphid occurrence, diluted with 40-60 kg water per mu
representative_examples.source_title: 2025 Technical Plan for Control of Major Grain Crop Pests and Diseases

representative_examples.dosage_and_method: 40-60 mL/mu, diluted with 40-50 kg water per mu, stem-and-leaf spray at early flowering or before Fusarium head blight occurrence
representative_examples.source_title: 2025 Technical Plan for Control of Major Grain Crop Pests and Diseases

interpretation: The value 35 is the number of usable reviewed recommendation entries generated after DeepResearch-enhanced evidence completion. It is not the total number of pesticides registered for wheat pest and disease control.
